An '''atmosphere generator''' was a device used to generate artificial [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheric]] conditions. Atmosphere generators used by the [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] produced [[Argon/Legends|argon]], an element critical to the health of the [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="SFS" />
